notes.title: 2020-03-11 Update log - Energy Fruit
notes.content:
Energy Fruit
Under the influence of the last Energy Shock, all fruits on this land had mutated and possessed incredible powers. Use these Energy Fruits to defeat the enemy.
Energy Fruit effect
Heart: Recover a little health
Apple: Increase attack card damage for one turn
Pear: Gain armor
Coconut: Increases shoot card damage for one turn
Grape: Increase magic card damage for one turn
Orange: Increase throw card damage of for one turn

Energy Fruits will appear randomly on the battlefield. Players or enemies move directly to the field to get fruit directly. The fruit refresh interval is 10 rounds.
The fruit of energy has an effect on both the enemy and player. When attacking the enemy, be careful not to let them eat the fruit first.
At the beginning of the battle, an energy apple will appear in the first tile, and after gaining it, you can increase 5 attack card damage for one turn. 

Other updates
-Initial gold coins changed to 50
-Villagers blessing now has more options
-Sunset Bow no longer causes disarm effect

notes.title: 2019-10-23 Update log Adding a tile card
notes.content:
Balance adjustment
Master's initial health is changed to 12
Ninja's initial health is changed to 18
Magic magnetic field modified to parcel card no longer get magic energy bonus

Add land card
Impact Change the current plot to a courage block. When attacking the plot, the attack card attack power increases!
Shooting Change the current parcel to the shooting parcel. The attack card attack power increases when standing on the parcel!
Throwing Change the current parcel to throw the parcel. When you stand on the parcel, the throwing card attack power increases!
Magical Magnetic Field Change the current plot to a magical block. The magic card attack power increases when standing on the plot!
Field Change the current plot to a defensive plot. At the end of the round, you will still gain armor on the plot!
Quicksand Change the current plot to a quicksand block. When attacking the plot, the attack card's attack power is reduced!
Stinger Change the current plot to a stinger plot. At the end of the round, the health is lost on the plot!
